value.rationale: This is a natural complete Euclidean edge metric invariant of an established infinite class whose face lattice is fixed for n>=m. It distinguishes count-weighted from length-weighted geometry by a sharp scaling threshold, including an exact Poisson conditional edge law; edge counts or f-vectors cannot express the length concentration. The point is the all-dimensional geometric sampling law, not the already-known elementary adjacency types.
